headline: Hallmark Gives AI Code a Visual Standard
lede: Hallmark directs coding agents toward deliberate interfaces instead of familiar AI-generated patterns. Its themes, asset workflows, responsive checks, and browser-based reviews turn visual quality into an explicit build process.

headline: TradingAgents Turns Market Research into Debate
lede: TradingAgents assembles analysts, debaters, risk managers, and portfolio logic into a graph-orchestrated research workflow. Checkpoints, persistent logs, parallel processing, and backtesting make the system inspectable rather than merely conversational.

headline: ThinkRail Builds a Control Room for Coding Agents
lede: ThinkRail gives autonomous coding tasks the structure of a serious engineering organization. Isolated worktrees, shared plans, reviews, CI checks, and merge flows let agents move in parallel without sacrificing oversight.

headline: Cindy Connects Agents to the Real World
lede: Cindy brings files, applications, browsers, phones, and coding harnesses under one locally extensible assistant. Switchable models, shared memory, skills, and MCP integrations keep practical automation close to the user’s own environment.

headline: ECC Turns Coding Assistants into Engineering Systems
lede: ECC replaces ad hoc prompting with a repeatable plan, test, review, verify, and remember cycle. Its agents, skills, hooks, persistent memory, and cross-tool adapters give the command line a disciplined operating model.

headline: Impeccable Makes Frontend Quality Measurable
lede: Impeccable equips coding agents with commands for critique, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, and polish. Deterministic detectors and durable product context give AI-assisted interface work a clearer quality bar.

headline: SkillSpector Inspects Agent Skills Before They Run
lede: SkillSpector treats third-party agent skills as a supply-chain boundary, scanning them for prompt injection, privilege escalation, data theft, and tool poisoning. Risk scores, SARIF output, OSV lookups, and safe ingestion make suspicious capabilities easier to stop before installation.

headline: Microduck Gives a Small Robot a Serious Runtime
lede: Microduck pairs learned locomotion with a compact Rust service architecture built for a 50 Hz control loop. Dedicated daemons, Unix-socket RPC, verified updates, and rollback support turn a charming biped into a carefully engineered platform.

headline: OpenBot Keeps AI Teammates Working After Hours
lede: OpenBot organizes persistent agents into isolated workspaces, queued tasks, shared channels, and durable conversations. Its desktop-first design supports long-running automation while keeping model selection, context usage, and delegation visible.

headline: Agent Reach Routes Around the API Bottleneck
lede: Agent Reach gives research agents a maintained path to live data across social and developer platforms. A primary-and-fallback dispatcher handles changing access routes while local credential storage keeps the retrieval layer auditable and close at hand.
